description: Recommend open models for a task on a device, from a natural-language question. Ranks ~20k indexed Hugging Face models by fit, task benchmark percentile (vendor vs independent kept apart), quant quality and speed. Examples: "best coding model for an RTX 4090 + 64GB RAM at 32k context", "Japanese chat on a Galaxy S25 Ultra", "serve 8 users on 2x RTX 3090".

default_hardware.description: device used when the question names none (preset id, e.g. "m4max-128").

question.default: best coding model for an RTX 4090 with 64GB RAM at 32k context
question.description: the request in plain words; name the device in it, or set default_hardware.

name: modelread_mcp_find_models
